neighbours.label: 'as yet' or 'previously' just before an un- word ('as yet unidentified', 'previously unknown'), and 'yet to be': the point where something is still not done; 'well known' and 'as usual' stay low.
fire: The museum holds a third sketch, as yet unsigned, by the same hand.
She has written a long, as yet unfinished, history of the port.
The fossil belongs to an as yet undescribed genus of beetle.
Divers found a previously uncharted reef off the northern coast.
Dozens of letters are yet to be catalogued by the archive.
The cause of the fire is, as yet, undetermined.
The victim was a local man whose name is as yet unreleased.
The study reports previously unrecorded behaviour in wild otters.
quiet: The museum holds a third sketch, carefully framed, by the same hand.
She has written a long, highly readable history of the port.
The fossil belongs to a common genus of beetle.
Divers found a beautiful coral reef off the northern coast.
Dozens of letters were catalogued last year by the archive.
The cause of the fire is, as usual, an electrical fault.
The victim was a local man whose name was well known.
The study reports familiar behaviour in wild otters.

predictions: 8/8 fire, 0 near misses. The output direction suppresses un- words on the + side, so this - pole promotes them.
